From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: negaré

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin negāre.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /neˈɡa.re/
  • Rhymes: -are
  • Hyphenation: ne‧gà‧re

Verb

[edit]

negàre (first-person singular present négo or nègo or (archaic) niègo or (ditto) niégo[1], first-person singular past historic negài, past participle negàto, auxiliary avére)

  1. (transitive) to deny
  2. (transitive) to negate
